title: Epithelial cell spreading assay on E-cadherin-coated glass or PDMS substrates for microscopy-based analysis of cadherin adhesions
protocol: Thoroughly mix equal quantities of CY-52-276 A and CY-52-276 B.
Pipette 120 μL of the mixture into the center of a single well from a 2-well Eppendorf chamber.
Spin-coat the solution using centrifugation for 1 min at 500 G to achieve an evenly spread flat gel.
Cure the gel for 2 h at 80°C.
Add 2 mL of 5% 3-aminopropyl trimethoxysilane (APTES) in 100% EtOH to silanize the gel.
Incubate the gel for 5 min at 20°C–22°C in a flow hood.
Wash the gel 3 times with 100% EtOH.
Dry the gel for 15 min at 80°C.
Add 2 mL of 200 nm carboxylated fluorescent beads to the gel.
Dilute carboxylated fluorescent beads 1:2000 in dH2O.
Sonicate the mixture for 10 minutes.
Pass the mixture through a 0.45 μm filter to prevent clumping of the beads.
Incubate the gel at 20°C–22°C for 5 minutes.
Wash the gel with dH2O three times.
Dry the gel for 15 minutes at 80°C.
Passivate the gel with 2 mL of 100 mM tris(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane (Tris) in dH2O for 5 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Wash the gel with dH2O three times.
Dry the gel for 15 minutes at 80°C.
Prepare glass coverslips as indicated.
Add 1 mL of 25 μg/mL Protein A in PBS to the coverslips.
Incubate the coverslips for 3 hours at 20°C–22°C.
Wash the coverslips with PBS three times.
Gently aspirate PBS from coverslips.
Add new PBS to coverslips to prevent them from falling dry.
Add 30 μL of 25 μg/mL hE-cadherin/Fc in PBS to coverslips.
For PDMS gels, add 200 μL of 25 μg/mL hE-cadherin/Fc in PBS.
Incubate coverslips for 16–20 hours at 4°C.
Wash coverslips three times with PBS.
Add 1 mL of 1% BSA in PBS to coverslips.
Incubate coverslips for 45 minutes at 20°C-22°C.
Wash coverslips three times with PBS.
Add 1 mL of movie media to coverslips.
E-cadherin-coated coverslips are ready for spreading assay.
If required, store substrates in the dark for up to one week.
Add 1X trypsin in PBS.
Incubate just long enough to see the first cells rounding up.
Resuspend cells in movie media.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 500 G to pellet cells.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in movie media.
Filter cells through 40 μm cell strainer to generate single cells.
Seed cells on top of prepared E-cadherin-coated substrates.
Closely monitor cells spreading.
